mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%m-%d') AS `date`, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM order_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(paid_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(paid_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%m-%d')

SELECT payment_method AS paymentMethod, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM order_info WHERE deleted = 0 AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_method
